{{nihongo|'''''Yellow Crow'''''|黄色いからす|Kiiroi Karasu|lead=yes}} is a 1957 Japanese [[Drama (film and television)|drama film]] directed by [[Heinosuke Gosho]].<ref name="jmdb" /><ref name="shochiku" /><ref name="Kinenote">{{cite web|url=http://www.kinenote.com/main/public/cinema/detail.aspx?cinema_id=25189 |title=黄色いからす |language=ja |publisher=Kinenote |access-date=27 December 2020}}</ref>

==Plot==
Kiyoshi Yoshida is a 9 year old boy who loves to draw. Although he shows some talent, his teacher is worried because he draws only in black and yellow, which can mean according to [[color psychology]] that the child has no parents or is unhappy in his family.

==Cast==
* [[Chikage Awashima]] as Machiko Yoshida
* [[Kinuyo Tanaka]] as Yukiko Mataumoto
* [[Koji Shitara]] as Kiyoshi Yoshida
* [[Yūnosuke Itō]] as Ichirō Yoshida
* [[Yoshiko Kuga]] as Yasuko Achihara
* [[Iida Chōko|Chōko Iida]] as grandmother
* [[Yoichi Numata|Yōichi Numata]] as Murakami

==Awards==
* [[Golden Globe Award for Best Foreign Language Film]] 1958<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.goldenglobes.com/film/kiiroi-karasu-yellow-crow |title=Kiiroi karasu (Yellow Crow) |website=Golden Globe Awards |access-date=14 June 2023}}</ref>

==Legacy==
''Yellow Crow'' was screened at the [[Museum of Modern Art]] in 2022 as part of its "Beyond Ozu: Hidden Gems of Shochiku Studios" retrospective.<ref name="moma">{{cite web|url=https://www.moma.org/calendar/events/7893 |title=Kiiroi karasu (Yellow Crow/Behold Thy Son). 1957. Directed by Heinosuke Gosho |website=Museum of Modern Art |access-date=19 July 2023}}</ref>
